origin.description: Mark a pull request for the ref argument of install_github.

arguments.name: pull
arguments.text: Character string specifying the pull request to install.

origin.details: The pull id is returned unchanged, with class github_pull. install_github treats that class as a pull request rather than a branch, tag, or commit.
origin.value: The pull id with class github_pull.

translation.description: Mark a pull request for the ref argument of install_github.

arguments.name: pull
arguments.text: Pull request id, kept as given. The manual example is the character string "42".

translation.details: The object stores the pull id and the class name github_pull. Printing follows R: the quoted id, then the class attribute.
translation.value: The pull id with class github_pull.
